messages:
Lena Ortiz: hey folks, day 2 here — trying to open Console (staging) -> Feature Flags to toggle a demo flag and I get a 403. demo in ~3h. who is the quickest person to get a temporary staging role? :grimacing:
Marco Ruiz: welcome Lena! :wave: paste the error and your console email and we'll route it. staging-only ok?
Lena Ortiz: lena.ortiz@redwood.com. error: `{\"status\":403, \"error\":\"forbidden\", \"reason\":\"requires role: ff_admin\"}` staging-only ok for 2h.
AccessBot: Request created (REQ-4810). Pre-check: user found, no elevated roles. Approval sent to Marco Ruiz and Priya Singh.
Priya Singh: I can approve staging-only for 2 hours. 
OnboardingBot: added checklist item to Lena's onboarding doc: "request temporary feature-flag access (staging)".
Marco Ruiz: granting `ff_admin (staging)` for 2 hours to lena.ortiz@redwood.com. Audit id REQ-4810. Confirm when you can access the flags list.
Lena Ortiz: I can see the feature flags now and toggled the `partner_demo_v2` flag. thanks so much! :relieved:
Lena Ortiz: quick follow-up 914 where do I look up who owns that flag so I can coordinate a permanent change?
Priya Singh: open the flag detail in Console, owner is shown at the top. if empty, ping #feature-flags and include the flag id + audit id (REQ-4810). CLI option: `rfctl flags describe partner_demo_v2 --env staging`.
Marco Ruiz: also add a 1-line note in the Flag Change log doc with the audit id so security can trace temporary grants.
Lena Ortiz: added the note and saved the audit id to my runbook. much appreciated everyone! :tada:
